context_note: Why this needs a person: the selected lineage is terminal, and OpenAI gates a full
re-login behind 2FA. The healer will not retry a terminal refresh token. Complete
the device-code login instead of waiting for the next scheduled cycle.
The 15-minute healer uses a pinned direct-refresh helper for one eligible renewable
lineage. It cannot recover this terminal lineage. Do not edit token fields by hand or
restore a backup; a prior request may have consumed the saved refresh token.
Use a FRESH authorization, not a copy of the one hermes-tmn holds. The two boxes
sharing one OAuth lineage is what caused the July outage: whichever box refreshes
last silently invalidates the other. The credential `label` field is cosmetic —
compare the refresh-token fingerprint printed in this alert, not labels.
